parent.status: failed diagnostic candidate (GPT FAIL); kept unmodified

build_rule: r98 is rebuilt reproducibly from the r95 working reconstruction: (1) declared topology, (2) declared rest-shape, (3) r97 mechanics re-applied unchanged (scripts/r97/scapula_pivot.py, add_gh_helper.py, helper_swing_half2.py), (4) r97 weight solver re-run on the new mesh (scripts/r97/solve_weights.py, r97 parameters as starting point). r97 itself is never opened for writing.

diagnosis.rest_slit: At rest the arm's inner wall lies ~2 cm from the lateral chest/back wall over ~12 cm; the walls meet at a sharp V apex near z=1.41 m. Overhead, the 1-2 quad rows at that apex must span the opened fossa (knife-edge membrane, SH-V02); at low/mid elevation with external rotation, horizontal adduction or arm-behind-torso the 2 cm gap closes and the walls interpenetrate.
diagnosis.stretch: edges with ratio>2.5 at flexion 170 have normal rest length (median 15 mm vs zone median 14 mm): an area deficit at the apex, not compressed rest rows.
diagnosis.r96_lesson: interpolated support rows alone regressed (r96 lower-support-rows screening); rest offsets of 8-12 mm on r96 support rows regressed squat. r98 therefore pairs topology with a rest-shape change and a re-solved (not interpolated) skin.

topology.operation: closed all-quad edge rings split once at their midpoints (bmesh subdivide_edges, cuts=1)
permitted_rings: torso rows through the left/right axillary apex band (closed 64-edge torso rings with rest z in [1.33, 1.43] m)
arm-root rings around the left/right humerus at the axillary junction (closed rings with rest z in [1.33, 1.45] m and |x| >= 0.15 m)
invariants: original vertex ids, original rest positions outside the rest-shape band, original weights and original shape-key points unchanged
exact left/right mirror symmetry (map rebuilt, max error < 1e-5 m)
new vertex weights/shape-key points interpolated, at most 4 deform influences

rest_shape.operation: open the axillary slit and round its apex: slit-wall vertices displaced along -normal with smooth falloff (trunk wall and arm inner wall), displacement diffused over the surface, apex band Laplacian-relaxed; left computed and mirrored; identical delta applied to Basis and every shape key
rest_shape.region: rest |x| >= 0.09 m, z in [1.15, 1.46] m, vertices facing the opposite wall of the slit within 4 cm, plus a diffusion band

weights.rule: localized re-skin with the r97 solver on the new topology; non-declared bone weights equal r95 (interpolated on new vertices); no broad weight-only retuning (solver parameters may only change for the new rows/apex band and must be recorded)

scope.mechanics: r97 AC-joint scapula pivot and glenohumeral half-swing helpers preserved unchanged
scope.correctives: r95 keys retained at value 0, drivers removed; no corrective fit authorised

no_regression_vs_r95: repo pose test squat_bottom, pullup_top, pullup_hang, pullup_hang_rhythm, press_top, press_top_rhythm, press_bottom self_intersecting_face_pairs (tolerance 5)
regression_gates.note: edge-count based metrics are compared with the topology change stated; the repo pose-test counts are reported as-is
